  <description>Implement a module to achieve serial input data accumulation output, input is 8bit data. The valid_in will be set to 1 before the first data comes in. Whenever the module receives 4 input data, the data_out outputs 4 received data accumulation results and sets the valid_out to be 1 (will last only 1 cycle).</description>
  <ports>
    <input id="clk" width_description="">Clock input for synchronization.</input>
    <input id="rst_n" width_description="">Active-low reset signal.</input>
    <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
    <input id="valid_in" width_description="">Input signal indicating readiness for new data.</input>
    <output id="valid_out" width_description="">Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached.</output>
    <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
  </ports>
  <implementation>When valid_in is 1, data_in is a valid input. 
Accumulate valid input data_in values directly to the output data_out. 
There is no output when there are fewer than four data_in inputs in the interim. Along with the output data_out, a cycle of valid_out=1 will appear as a signal. 
The valid_out signal is set to 1 when the data_out outputs 4 received data accumulation results. Otherwise, it is set to 0.
    </implementation>
  <task>Give me the complete Verilog code.</task>
</module>
